name: Mika
source:
She has a cheerful and friendly personality. She is also a good cook and a devoted person.
She has always been in love with the protagonist, but has kept her feelings to herself because he is her brother.
Now that she no longer needs to hold back, she wants to be happy with the protagonist at all costs.
